need: Written before opening the document: I want the mechanism itself, stated in the abstract way an economist would recognise it, without naming any region — how can a pre-industrial society raise what it produces and still leave its people at subsistence?
query: how can a pre-industrial society raise what it produces and still leave ordinary people at bare subsistence

alternates.quote: when the growth of output (as it is accompanied by a faster demographic growth) does not lead in the long-range perspective to the increase in per capita output and the improvement of living conditions of the majority of population that remains close to the bare survival level

chain.title: East Africa in the Malthusian trap? A statistical analysis of financial, economic, and demographic indicators
chain.author: Andrey Korotayev; Julia Zinkina
